unit_routes.title: Preserve the deployed baseline and clear execution preflights
unit_routes.capability_profile: repository forensics, Cloudflare operations, secret hygiene
unit_routes.rationale: High risk (baseline preservation) but medium complexity; DeepSeek's strong reasoning prevents destructive mistakes. Low token volume (git commands, JSON output).

unit_routes.title: Add provenance, source-policy, claim, observation, and lifecycle schema
unit_routes.capability_profile: SQLite/D1 modeling, temporal data, provenance systems
unit_routes.rationale: Highest-risk schema design; errors cascade to all downstream units. DeepSeek's strong reasoning for SQL and temporal data modeling.

unit_routes.title: Introduce external ingestion contract v2 with backward compatibility
unit_routes.capability_profile: JSON Schema, Hono/Zod, API compatibility, idempotency
unit_routes.rationale: External contract boundary affects all collectors. DeepSeek for precise schema design and backward-compat reasoning.

unit_routes.title: Implement immutable evidence registration and R2 snapshot storage
unit_routes.rationale: Security-critical streaming and R2 integration. DeepSeek for correctness in content-addressed storage and auth.

unit_routes.title: Add dedicated asynchronous scrape-ingestion processing
unit_routes.capability_profile: Cloudflare Queues, idempotent workflows, D1 checkpoints
unit_routes.rationale: Queue infrastructure with idempotency requirements. DeepSeek for durable workflow design.

unit_routes.title: Build the portable external collector core and policy engine
unit_routes.capability_profile: Python, HTTP, robots, SSRF prevention, containers, budget systems
unit_routes.rationale: Core collector with security-critical SSRF and budget enforcement. DeepSeek for multi-domain Python security design.

unit_routes.title: Implement the official manufacturer pilot adapter
unit_routes.capability_profile: HTML/API extraction, robotics specifications, fixture design
unit_routes.rationale: Medium risk adapter; Qwen is sufficient for structured extraction. Falls back to GLM if unavailable.

unit_routes.capability_profile: catalog APIs, time-series offers, currency/region data
unit_routes.rationale: Medium risk; Qwen handles catalog API and time-series patterns well.

unit_routes.capability_profile: GitHub REST, repository graphs, BOM parsing, path security
unit_routes.rationale: High risk due to API version pinning, path security, and BOM parsing. DeepSeek for security-critical design.

unit_routes.capability_profile: secure parsing, robotics formats, PDF/spreadsheet/XML security
unit_routes.rationale: Security-critical parser design with XXE, YAML, and archive-bomb defenses. DeepSeek for vulnerability-aware design.

unit_routes.title: Implement normalization, identity candidates, conflicts, and lifecycle services
unit_routes.capability_profile: entity resolution, temporal conflicts, units/currency, property testing
unit_routes.rationale: Algorithmic entity resolution with temporal conflict modeling. DeepSeek for correctness in identity matching and lifecycle transitions.

unit_routes.title: Extend administrator review and provenance APIs/UI
unit_routes.capability_profile: Hono auth, React admin UI, audit workflows, API compatibility
unit_routes.rationale: Auth-critical UI/API changes with audit trail requirements. DeepSeek for authorization design and React component architecture.

unit_routes.title: Add scheduling, budget enforcement, observability, and GitHub Actions workflow
unit_routes.capability_profile: GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Cron, cost control, observability, distributed leases
unit_routes.rationale: Budget enforcement and cron scheduling with hard USD 50 gate. DeepSeek for cost-control correctness.

unit_routes.title: Create the complete source coverage matrix and pilot registry
unit_routes.rationale: Medium risk taxonomy work; large context (1,694 inventory lines) but mechanical mapping. Qwen handles large-context classification well.

unit_routes.title: Build the complete offline verification and compatibility suite
unit_routes.capability_profile: test architecture, Cloudflare integration tests, security fixtures, CI
unit_routes.rationale: Integration test suite spanning all prior units. DeepSeek for comprehensive test architecture and security fixture design.

unit_routes.capability_profile: release management, Cloudflare operations, data review, incident recovery
unit_routes.rationale: Release-critical operations. DeepSeek for rollout safety and rollback verification. Note: final approval gate may use reserved GPT-5.6-sol.
